name: cellcog
description: Hand CellCog a brief and get finished work back: research with sources, PDFs and slide decks, spreadsheets, dashboards and web apps, diagrams, images, video, voiceover and music. Hire AI employees for ongoing projects.

interface.longDescription: CellCog is an AI sub-agent you hand a brief to. An agent does the whole job and returns finished work: research briefs with sources, PDFs and slide decks, spreadsheets with live formulas, dashboards and web apps, diagrams, data analysis and code, and, when the brief asks for it, images, video with dialogue, voiceover and music. Files come back as links valid for 30 days. For a project you return to over days or months, hire a CellCog AI employee: it keeps memory, skills and routines, and you message it like a teammate. Everything runs on the CellCog account you sign in with; work spends that account's credits. CellCog does not edit files on your computer, and it does not post or send anything on your behalf from this connector.
defaultPrompt: Write a cited PDF brief on my market.
Turn these notes into a 10-slide deck.
Hire an AI employee to run my content calendar.

positive.prompt: Use CellCog to write a two-page PDF brief on the US cold brew coffee market with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: A chat starts at once; polling get_result shows progress notes, then the final message with a PDF link and its first page previewed.

positive.prompt: Ask CellCog to make that brief one page and add a chart of market size.
positive.expected_behavior: The same chat continues; the new result is a one-page PDF with a chart.

positive.prompt: Have CellCog make a square product photo of a matte black coffee tumbler on a wooden desk.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an image file link and an inline preview of the photo.

positive.description: Hire and message an AI employee
positive.prompt: Hire a CellCog AI employee as a social media manager for a small coffee brand, then ask it what it needs from me.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the new employee's id and shift 1; its first reply introduces itself and asks for brand details.

positive.prompt: How many CellCog credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account's email, plan and credit balance.

negative.description: Not a CellCog job: editing local code
negative.prompt: Refactor the function in the file I have open.
Post this image to my Instagram account.

review.commerce_description: CellCog sells nothing inside the client; work spends the signed-in account's credits.

publication.release_notes: Skills updated: Core is now the default tier in every mode; pass max for heavy work and flash for quick assets.
